name: agent-qa
description: Natural-language web and mobile testing from vostride, with advanced memidex memory and self-improvement through learned application knowledge and replay. Author tests, run journeys, and inspect recorded evidence through MCP.

AGENT_QA_CONFIG.description: Absolute path to agent-qa.config.yaml in a project initialized with agent-qa. See https://vostride.com/docs/agent-qa/quickstart for model and browser/device setup.

npm.description: Requires Node.js 24+ and an initialized agent-qa project. Configure a model and browser or mobile device support before running tests. Model-provider costs may apply.
